about.description: Career Assistant is an open-source, self-hosted career explorer: an AI job catalog with a family tree and relation graph, transparent AI match scoring and university pathways for students deciding their future. Runs with Docker, brings your own AI.

explore.nothingMatchesBody: Loosen a filter or ask an admin to connect more posting sources.
explore.searchSaved: Search saved — schedule it in Settings → Scheduler.

postings.title: Postings
postings.bookmarkHint: Bookmark postings to keep them here.
postings.connectSourceHint: Ask an admin to connect a posting source (ATS feed, RSS, CSV) to see real vacancies here.

universities.subtitle: Upload your country’s admissions/prospectus PDF. The AI extracts departments and yearly entry baselines, which then connect to jobs on each job page.
universities.dropHint: Drop a university catalog PDF or click to upload
universities.noneYetBody: Add them here by uploading an admissions PDF — departments and baselines are extracted automatically.

universityDetail.noDepartmentsBody: Add a department manually, or upload an admissions PDF on the Universities page — the AI extracts departments and baselines for you.

profileImport.title: Import from CV
profileImport.subtitle: Upload a CV and confirm what we extract — nothing is added without your tick.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.subtitle: Describe a goal once — the agent searches while you live your life. It never applies for you.

autopilot.noSurvivors: No matches survived the filters this run.
autopilot.deleteBody: Its runs and findings go with it. This cannot be undone.
autopilot.hideLikeThis: Hide like this — the goal learns to skip these

validation.goal: Describe your goal in a few words.

scheduler.noSavedSearches: No saved searches yet — save one from the Live tab first.

notifications.browserBody: Push when the tab is closed (web push / VAPID).
notifications.kindsBody: Choose what reaches your inbox. Per-kind channels follow the defaults unless overridden.

users.resetNote: Password reset for {{email}} — share it out-of-band.

aiSettings.title: AI Configuration
aiSettings.subtitle: Every AI feature (matching, generation, parsing, chat) runs on the resolved provider/model.
aiSettings.nothingBody: Without providers the built-in env default (AI_PROVIDER=mock) serves every task.

providers.hint: A provider is an API endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio…) holding the key and base URL.
providers.noModelsHint: Register a model first — the connection test sends a tiny completion.
providers.deleteDescription: Its models and task assignments will be removed too.

models.noCatalogHint: This provider type doesn't expose a model catalog — enter the model id manually.
models.intro: Register the models each provider serves — add them from the provider's live catalog or by typing the model id.
models.capsHint: Guessed from the model id — toggle what the model can do.
models.emptyProviderLabel: No models registered yet — use Add model to pick from the catalog or enter an id manually.
models.providersEmptyLabel: No providers configured yet — add one in the Providers tab first, then register its models here.
models.deleteBody: Tasks that used this model fall back to their scope default.

tasks.title: Task Assignments
tasks.fallbackSectionHint: Used by every task without its own assignment in this scope.
tasks.fallbackInfo: This model serves every task that has no assignment in this scope.
tasks.tasksSectionHint: Overrides the fallback model above for that task.
tasks.unassignedMeta: Unassigned — falls back to the fallback model above.
tasks.scopeEmpty: No models are registered in this scope yet — add one on the Models tab, then assign it here.
tasks.nonAdminNote: Global assignments are managed by an administrator; set personal overrides to customize your own AI models.

cvStudio.title: CV Studio
cvStudio.subtitle: Build tailored CVs from your profile — every line traceable to your own evidence.
cvStudio.emptyBody: Create your first CV — it starts from your profile data and you choose exactly what goes in.

cvStudio.modeLabel: How do you want to start?

cvStudio.noTemplateNote: No template chosen — the CV will use the studio default. Choose one below, or let AI pick for you.
